sources.title: OCR Releases Video on HIPAA Security Rule Risk Management Requirements
sources.key_facts: Confirms April 2026 release of OCR video on HIPAA Security Rule Risk Management; presenter Nicholas Heesters, Senior Advisor for Cybersecurity; topics covered; YouTube channel hosting; December 2025 solicitation of questions.

sources.title: OCR Releases Risk Management Video

sources.title: HHS OCR Enforcement Priorities for 2026
sources.key_facts: Reports statements by OCR Director Paula M. Stannard that 2026 enforcement initiative will expand from risk analysis to include risk management noncompliance.
